name: meetbridge
description: A macOS Google Meet app powered by embedded Chromium.

scripts.build:safari-extension: xcodebuild -project MeetBridge.xcodeproj -scheme MeetBridgeExtension -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/safari-extension CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: MeetBridge uses your camera for Google Meet calls.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MeetBridge uses your microphone for Google Meet calls.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: MeetBridge captures system audio only when you choose to share it in Google Meet.
